control.runtime: Actual prechange PR59 kit/batch/status_overlay/prior_research snapshots, otherwise existing current compiler
control.competent_use: Full existing frozen evidence and qualified prior work available; same context may preserve research; no artificial withholding or forced reinvestigation.

treatment.runtime: Ordinary prepare with unset-status full dossier; preserve populated lifecycle sheet through reviewed overlay

shared_required_outcome: Source-supported provisional-status recommendation plus complete lifecycle or explicitly blocked usable partial, distinct independent status/lifecycle verdicts, actual consumer checks, unchanged approval boundaries
setup_cost_policy: Count isolated compiler build and code integration once; report other shared setup separately. Include failed preparation, source work, reviews, correction, coordination and final integration. Sum task intervals separately from wall-clock.
limits: Disjoint historical cases selected by existing held target/actor leads, not known answers.
Single-case arms cannot isolate difficulty differences or support campaign forecasts.
No credit if competent legacy workflow already retains substantive investigation in the same context.
October24 interrupted research and October25 recovery remain costs; inactive interruption is not active labor.
Historical six-case packet experiment increased combined time and input tokens despite faster producers; combined reviewer/correction costs are required here.
selection_and_timing_note: Arm assignment communicated before substantive conclusions; this file records it during source research, not randomized preregistration.
